Placemaker.Recipe.UrbanFarm.Description: Intensive city growing: market garden beds, vineyard rows, glasshouses, lavender or raised beds, with tracks, a farmyard and hedges.
Placemaker.UrbanFarm.Name: Urban farm
Placemaker.UrbanFarm.Issue.NoFields: No room for fields: the area is too narrow for the field size.
Placemaker.UrbanFarm.crop.Tooltip: What grows in the fields. Mixed gives neighbouring fields different crops.
Placemaker.UrbanFarm.rows.Tooltip: Rows along the long side of the plot, across it, or diagonally.
Placemaker.UrbanFarm.density.Tooltip: Closer rows and plants above 100 %, wider below. Very large farms widen the spacing to stay within the object budget.
Placemaker.UrbanFarm.polytunnels.Tooltip: Market garden: every third field becomes a range of glasshouses.
Placemaker.UrbanFarm.fieldSize.Tooltip: Length of a field between cross tracks; fields are about 60 % as wide.
Placemaker.UrbanFarm.tracks.Tooltip: Spine: one long track with cross tracks. Grid: tracks round every field. Loop: a track round the inside of the edge. None: grass headlands only.
Placemaker.UrbanFarm.farmyard.Tooltip: A gravel yard by the entrance with a barn, water tanks, crates and machinery.
Placemaker.UrbanFarm.farmShop.Tooltip: A produce stand at the yard's entrance end.
Placemaker.UrbanFarm.windbreak.Tooltip: A row of trees just inside the edge, with gaps at the entrances.
Placemaker.UrbanFarm.terrain.Tooltip: Terraces for vines on a slope, a level pad for glasshouses, or gentle swells. Always blended back to the original ground at the edge. Permanent.
Placemaker.UrbanFarm.soilPaint.Tooltip: Paints the terrain texture under the crop fields. Permanent.
Placemaker.UrbanFarm.soilLayer.Tooltip: Which of the map's four extra terrain textures to paint (depends on the map).
Placemaker.UrbanFarm.benchSpacing.Toolti: Benches beside the tracks every so many metres; 0 = none.
Placemaker.UrbanFarm.scarecrows.Tooltip: Scarecrows per hectare, in the middle of the largest crop fields.
Placemaker.UrbanFarm.waterTanks.Tooltip: A water tank at the track corner of each large field and by the glasshouses.
Placemaker.AddOn.HoneyHives.Name: Beehives
Placemaker.AddOn.HoneyHives.layout.Toolt: Hives in short rows facing the middle, or in a circle facing out.
Placemaker.AddOn.HoneyHives.fence.Toolti: A small fence round the bee yard with a gate towards the middle.
Flower beds round the back of the bee yard.
Placemaker.AddOn.FarmStall.Name: Farm stall
Placemaker.AddOn.FarmStall.crates.Toolti: Crates of produce either side of the stall.
